# Случаи TestGuardBash: команда — как её получает guard сессии (.claude/hooks/guard-bash.sh).
# «B » — отказ, «A » — пропуск; ⏎ — перевод строки, ⇥ — табуляция. Ничего из этого не исполняется.

# --- отказ: флаги обхода хуков и путь хуков git
B git commit -n -m x
B git commit -an -m x
B git commit -m x -n
B git commit "-n" -m x
B git commit '-an' -m x
B git add -A⏎git commit -n -m x
B git push --no-verify
B git push --no-veri origin main
B git push "--no-veri" origin main
B git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null push
B git config core.hooksPath /dev/null
B git config --unset core.hooksPath
B git commit -nm x
B git commit -sn -m x
B git commit --no-verify -m x
B git commit -m x --no-veri
B git -C . commit -n -m x
B git -c user.name=x commit -q -n -m y
B /usr/bin/git commit -n -m x
B git push origin main --no-verify
B true && git commit -n -m x
B git stash; git commit -n -m x
B git push '--no-verify' origin main
B git commit -m "x\|y" -n
B git commit -n -m "x"
B git commit --no-veri -m x
B git commit -anm "x"
B git -C /tmp commit -n -m x
B GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/dev/null git push
B git push --no-veri
B git push origin main --no-verif
B git add . && git commit -n -m x
B git status; git commit -n -m x
B (git commit -n -m x)
B git commit --amend --no-edit -n
B git commit -qn -m x
B git   commit   -n  -m x
B for i in 1; do git commit -n -m x; done
B git -c user.name=x commit -n -m y
B git commit -F- -n <<EOF⏎feat: x⏎EOF
B git add -A⏎git commit -n -m "fix: x"
B cd /repo⏎git commit -n -m "fix: x"
B git status⏎git push --no-veri
B git --git-dir .git commit -n -m x
B git --git-dir .git push --no-veri
B git --work-tree . commit -n -m x
B git merge --no-veri feature
B git commit -m x -n; echo "it's done"
B git -c core.hookspath=/dev/null push origin main
B git push --no-verify origin v1.3.0
B git config --get core.hooksPath

# --- отказ: запись в хук: команды-писатели и перенаправления
B chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B cd scripts/git-hooks && chmod -x commit-msg
B rm scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B mv scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /tmp/
B echo 'exit 0' > scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B git checkout HEAD~1 -- scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B echo "a\|b" ; chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo x >& scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo x>scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo x >|scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B cat /dev/null 1>scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B tee scripts/git-hooks/pre-push </dev/null
B dd if=/dev/null of=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B truncate -s 0 scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B ln -sf /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B install -m 644 /dev/null scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git rm -q scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B git mv scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg.off
B git restore --source=20a5b14 scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git apply /tmp/x.patch --include=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo 'exit 0' >scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo x &> scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B : > scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B true >| scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B cat /dev/null >> scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B chmod a-x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B chmod 644 scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B mv scripts/git-hooks/pre-push scripts/git-hooks/pre-push.off
B rm -f scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B perl -pi -e 's/make check/true/' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B grep -rl x . | xargs -I{} cp {} scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo "a" 'b' ; chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B rm scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B mv scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /tmp/x
B git rm scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B cd scripts/git-hooks && chmod -x pre-push
B truncate -s 0 scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B : > scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo 'exit 0' > scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B install -m 755 /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git checkout HEAD~5 -- scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git restore scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B printf 'exit 0' | tee scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B python3 -c "open('scripts/git-hooks/pre-push','w').write('')"
B perl -pi -e 's/make/true/' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B chmod 644 scripts/git-hooks/pre-push && git push
B rm -f 'scripts/git-hooks/pre-push'
B git mv scripts/git-hooks/pre-push scripts/x
B env FOO=1 chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sudo chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B cd scripts && chmod -x git-hooks/pre-push
B git commit \⏎  -n -m x
B git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'⏎feat: x⏎EOF⏎)" -n

# --- отказ: запись и запуск через «читателей»: cp, sort, find, awk, sed, git, rg, bash -n
B sed -i 's/make check/true/' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B cp -t scripts/git-hooks /tmp/pre-push
B sort -o scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B find scripts -name pre-push -exec chmod -x {} +
B find scripts/git-hooks -name pre-push -delete
B find /dev/null -fprint scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk -i inplace '{print}' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk 'BEGIN{system("chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push")}'
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push 2>/dev/null
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push 2>&1
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push >/dev/null
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push>/dev/null
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push 2> /dev/null
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push </dev/null
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push 2>&1 | tail -1
B cp -f /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push 2>/dev/null; echo done
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push -f
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push -v
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push --
B cp /tmp/fixed scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg # вернуть хук
B cp /tmp/pre-push scripts/git-hooks/ 2>&1
B cp -f /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg || true
B cp /tmp/fixed scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg && git add -A
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push $EMPTY
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push "$@"
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push -S x
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push --suffix x
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push --no-preserve mode
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push --sparse always
B cp --target-directory=scripts/git-hooks /tmp/pre-push
B cp --targ scripts/git-hooks /tmp/pre-push
B cp {/bin/true,scripts/git-hooks/pre-push}
B "cp" /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B \cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B command cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/*
B sort --output=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort --out=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort --outp scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort "-o" scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort '-o' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort \-o scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort $'-o' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort -uo scripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort -oscripts/git-hooks/pre-push /dev/null
B sort /dev/null -o scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sort {-o,scripts/git-hooks/pre-push} /dev/null
B sort $OPT scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sort --co=/tmp/evil.sh scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B find scripts/git-hooks -name pre-push "-delete"
B find scripts/git-hooks -name pre-push '-delete'
B find scripts/git-hooks -name pre-push -del''ete
B find scripts/git-hooks -name pre-push \-delete
B find scripts/git-hooks -name pre-push $'\x2ddelete'
B find scripts/git-hooks -type f -exec⇥chmod -x {} +
B find scripts/git-hooks -type f "-exec" chmod -x {} +
B find scripts/git-hooks -type f -execdir chmod -x {} +
B find scripts/git-hooks -type f -ok rm {} \;
B find /dev/null -fprintf scripts/git-hooks/pre-push x
B find /dev/null -fls scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B find scripts/git-hooks $ACTION
B awk 'BEGIN{print "exit 0" | "tee scripts/git-hooks/pre-push"}'
B awk 'BEGIN{"chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push" | getline}'
B awk 'BEGIN{printf "" > "scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg"}'
B awk -v f=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push 'BEGIN{printf "" > f}'
B awk 'BEGIN{close("scripts/git-hooks/pre-push"); printf "" | "cat > scripts/git-hooks/pre-push"}'
B awk '{system("chmod -x " FILENAME)}' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk '{print > FILENAME}' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk '{print "chmod -x " FILENAME | "sh"}' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk -v c=sh '{print "chmod -x " FILENAME | c}' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk -f /tmp/p.awk scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B gawk --dump-variables=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push 'BEGIN{}'
B gawk -oscripts/git-hooks/pre-push 'BEGIN{}'
B gawk -e 'BEGIN{x=1}' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk '@load "filefuncs"' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk "BEGIN{system(\"chmod -x $H\")}" scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B awk {print\>FILENAME} scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sed -n 'w scripts/git-hooks/pre-push' /dev/null
B sed -n 'wscripts/git-hooks/pre-push' /dev/null
B sed -n '1e chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push' /etc/hostname
B sed 's/make check/true/w scripts/git-hooks/pre-push' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sed --expression='w scripts/git-hooks/pre-push' /dev/null
B sed --expr 'w scripts/git-hooks/pre-push' /dev/null
B sed -ne 'w scripts/git-hooks/pre-push' /dev/null
B sed -l 5 'w scripts/git-hooks/pre-push' /dev/null
B sed -n '1s/.*/chmod -x scripts\/git-hooks\/pre-push/ep' /etc/hostname
B sed -i.bak 's/x/y/' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sed -ni 's/x/y/' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sed --in 's/make check/true/' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sed --in-pl 's/x/y/' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B sed "-i" 's/x/y/' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git diff --output=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git log -1 --output=scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B git show --output=scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg HEAD
B git show HEAD:Makefile --output=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git diff "--output=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push"
B git diff --outp=scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git add --chmod=-x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git grep -O'chmod -x' -e . -- scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git grep --open-files-in-pager=rm -e . -- scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B rg --pre /tmp/evil.sh x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B rg --pre=/tmp/evil.sh x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B bash -n +n -c 'chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push'
B cp /tmp/pre-push scripts/git-hooks/
B git update-index --chmod=-x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg </dev/null
B sed -i 's/exit 1/exit 0/' scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B cp /bin/true scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B awk 'BEGIN{print "exit 0" > "scripts/git-hooks/pre-push"}'
B git update-index --chmod=-x scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B sed -i '2i exit 0' scripts/git-hooks/pre-push

# --- отказ: экранированная кавычка не прячет следующую команду
B echo don\'t; chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo \" ; chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo don\'t && rm scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg
B echo 'it'\''s' ; chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo $'a\'b' ; chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo "x\\" ; chmod -x scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B echo don\'t; git commit -n -m x
B echo \" ; git commit -n -m x

# --- отказ: код для оболочки-интерпретатора — строка в кавычках, тело heredoc и текст echo рядом с ней
B bash -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B sh -c "git commit -n -m x"
B eval "git commit -n -m x"
B printf 'git commit -n -m x' | bash
B bash -e -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B bash -euo pipefail -c 'git add -A && git commit -n -m x'
B bash --norc -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B bash --rcfile 'my rc' -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B bash -cx 'git commit -n -m x'
B bash -e \⏎  -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B bash \⏎  -e -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B bash -c 'git commit \⏎  -n -m x'
B echo start⏎bash -e -c 'git commit -n -m x'⏎echo done
B "bash" -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B ba""sh -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B \bash -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B $'bash' -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B bash "-c" 'git commit -n -m x'
B /bin/bash -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B env bash -euc 'git commit -n -m x'
B zsh -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B dash -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B ksh -c 'git commit -n -m x'
B "eval" 'git commit -n -m x'
B bash -c 'git push --no-verify'
B bash -e -c 'git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null push'
B printf 'git commit -n -m x' | bash -x

B printf 'git commit -n -m x' | bash -
B printf 'git commit -n -m x' | bash /dev/stdin

B cat <<'EOF' | bash -x⏎git commit -n -m x⏎EOF
B bash -e <<'EOF'⏎git commit -n -m x⏎EOF
B sh<<<'git commit -n -m x'

# --- отказ: алиасы и include конфига git — и значением в кавычках с пробелом
B git -c alias.c='commit -n' c -m x
B git config alias.p 'push --no-verify'
B git -c include.path=/tmp/x.cfg push
B git config --global include.path /tmp/x.cfg
B git -c 'alias.c=commit -n' c -m x
B git -c "alias.c=commit -n" c -m x
B git -c $'alias.c=commit -n' c -m x
B git -c 'alias.c=!git commit -n' c -m x
B git  -c  'alias.c=commit -n'  c -m x
B git -c'alias.c=commit -n' c -m x
B git -c \⏎  'alias.c=commit -n' c -m x
B git -C . -c 'alias.c=commit -n' c -m x
B git -c 'include.path=/tmp/my cfg' push
B git -c "includeIf.gitdir:/.path=/tmp/my cfg" push
B git --config-env=alias.c=X c -m x
B GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=alias.c GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0='commit -n' git c -m x
B GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS="'alias.c=commit -n'" git c -m x
B git -c ALIAS.c='commit -n' c -m x

# --- отказ по замыслу, цена правил: интерпретатор в команде снимает кавычки со всей строки
B git commit -m "fix: -n flag" && bash -c 'make check'
B echo "pre-push ok" && bash -c 'make check'
B grep -n "x | sh -e" scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
B git config --get alias.co

# --- пропуск: чтение хуков, текст о них и обычная работа
A git push origin main
A git log -n 5
A make hooks
A git commit -m "fix: -n в сообщении"
A git commit -m "fix(gate): commit-msg и pre-push"
A git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'⏎fix: x⏎⏎git commit -n и core.hooksPath в теле⏎EOF
A grep -rn core.hooksPath scripts/
A cat scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
A bash -n scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg

A grep -rn "commit-msg" --include='*.md' .

A git log --grep "commit-msg" --format=%s

A git commit -m "chore(gate): pre-push по дереву коммита, commit-msg, release-diff"

A git tag -a v1.4.0 -F - <<'EOF'⏎v1.4.0⏎⏎Гейт: commit-msg и pre-push, git commit -n не нужен⏎EOF

A find . -name pre-push -not -path './.git/*'
A wc -l scripts/git-hooks/pre-push && sort scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg | head

A make check 2>&1 | tee /tmp/commit-msg.log
A go test ./scripts/ -run TestGuardBash
A git commit -m "fix(gate): pre-push проверяет пушимый коммит"
A git add scripts/git-hooks/pre-push

A git diff scripts/git-hooks/pre-push

A git commit -m "feat: x -n something"

A git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'⏎feat(gate): x⏎⏎SKIP_PREPUSH=1 core.hooksPath GOFLAGS=-n⏎EOF⏎)"

A git -C /path log -n 3
A git config --list | grep -i hook
A make check
A git commit -m "fix: x"
A git status && git diff
A git clean -n
A git stash push -m wip
A echo "git commit -n"
A git commit -S -m x
A git commit -s -m x
A git commit --dry-run

A git show --stat HEAD -n 1
A git commit -m x -- file-n.go
A git rev-list -n 1 HEAD
A sed -n 1,20p scripts/git-hooks/pre-push
